title: wg: content-09 §6.1 receiver handling of non-deterministic CBOR
description: Suggestion. §6.1 (L1870) makes deterministic encoding a sender MUST but says nothing about receivers, which matters because MessageId hashes the bytes as received. mimid rejects non-deterministic input (decision mimid-1wgh.2.9). Fix: specify reject or accept.
notes:
Verified 2026-10-18 vs -06/-09/-04 (= main): PARTLY: rationale backwards (hash over received bytes = same ID); real point is interop + missing §9.1 entry. New issue.

Filed 2026-10-18: https://github.com/ietf-wg-mimi/draft-ietf-mimi-content/issues/83
2026-11-02 reconcile: Filed as content#83 (closed) / PR#87 (merged). -10 §6.1: receivers MUST reject indefinite length and duplicate map keys. Remaining: PR#87's 'SHOULD accept unsorted maps and non-shortest encodings' became non-normative 'receivers are not expected to strictly enforce', so a strict receiver may still reject and members can diverge. Unfiled; arguably the editors' deliberate choice.
